objective: Measure phases and doubling rounds of the w-distinction law (with and without copies) on small random atom patterns at the jump, layered random circuits, ladders, pyramids and balanced trees, against frozen predictions.
status: Supported 2026-11-16 (referee pending): frozen run of 305 cases, all gates held; 3 of 7 predictions held (Q3b, Q4, Q5 where evaluable) and 4 failed (Q1 at n = 4096: 0.70 < 0.75; Q1b gain 0.104 > 0.10; Q2 rounds saved more, ratio 0.685..0.73; Q3 layered gains mostly zero). Keeping rarely saves a phase on random patterns (0% before the narrowest phase, 6-12% after); spend-only w = 2 cuts rounds by 22-32%.
title: Phases and doubling rounds against the number of carried distinctions
